plainLanguage: Section 47 inakataza, moja kwa moja au indirectly, kushawishi desertion, kusaidia desertion, au kumficha mtu ukiwa na reason to believe kuwa ni deserter, kwa members wa vyombo vilivyotajwa.
meaning: The section reaches procurement/persuasion, assistance/accessory conduct, and harbouring/concealment where the required reason to believe exists.
keyPoints: Direct and indirect conduct are covered.
Attempts to procure or persuade desertion are included.
Aiding, abetting or being accessory to desertion is included.
Harbouring/concealing requires reason to believe the person is a deserter.
The stated penalty is six months' imprisonment.

legalTerms.meaning: Kuacha service/duty kwa namna inayotambuliwa na sheria husika.
Statutory mental threshold attached to harbouring or concealment.

examples.title: Element check
examples.scenario: Prosecution allegation is assessed against the exact wording of this section.
examples.analysis: Kila statutory element lazima ithibitishwe; label ya offence peke yake haitoshi.

history.summary: Section 47 forms part of Chapter VII, Treason and Other Offences Against the Republic.
notes: Official wording checked against the R.E. 2022 source before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Analysis should follow the exact statutory verbs and mental elements rather than a broad description of the alleged conduct.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The evidence should be matched separately to each required element and any express qualification in the provision.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inayodaiwa inathibitisha kila element ya section 47 bila kupanua wording ya statute?
